item: player-controls (Android, branch android-int-oct3): (1) favourite heart in the full player's toggle row, plus the mini player and the lock-screen Like; (2) previous/next press morph settles like play/pause (220 ms); (3) remove "Now Playing" and the cloud icon from the full player's top bar; the output pill shows the output device's name (Bluetooth, wired/USB, Cast, Spotify Connect); the phone speaker stays icon-only. Applies to Material and glass modes.
currentBehaviour:
(1) FAVOURITE: the heart is not stale by design. Data path:
- tap → PlayerViewModel.toggleFavorite / toggleFavoriteSpecificSong (PlayerViewModel.kt:2410-2438) → musicRepository.setFavoriteStatus, a Room write on IO (MusicRepositoryImpl.kt:814-826).
- Room Flow favoritesDao.getFavoriteSongIds() (FavoritesDao.kt:25-28; MusicRepositoryImpl.kt:834-838) → favoriteSongIds StateFlow (PlayerViewModel.kt:1316-1318) → isCurrentSongFavorite = combine(resolved current id, ids) (:1320-1337).
- Collected in UnifiedPlayerSheetV2.kt:209, then passed as a Boolean at :851 and :913.
- UnifiedPlayerSheetLayers.kt:221-227 (and the prewarm layer, :332-333) wraps it in rememberUpdatedState plus a provider lambda. The toggle rows read the provider in their own composition: Material BottomToggleRow (FullPlayerContent.kt:2914), glass GlassPlayerToggleRow (GlassPlayerControls.kt:118), and the lyrics More sheet (LyricsMoreBottomSheet.kt:714-724 → BottomToggleRow.kt:37).
- The rememberUpdatedState write during the parent's recomposition invalidates exactly those readers, so the heart redraws after the Room round trip (a few frames). Shuffle and repeat play no part.
- Song-info sheet: observeSong combines favoriteSongIds (PlayerViewModel.kt:1504-1511; UnifiedPlayerOverlaysLayer.kt:227-237). Also live.

One real lag: unliking a Spotify track that came only from Explore.
- toggleFavoriteSpecificSong first awaits spotifyRepository.removeFromExploredCatalog (PlayerViewModel.kt:2427-2434).
- That runs syncUnifiedLibrarySongsFromSpotify() and mirrorPlaylistsIntoApp(), a whole Spotify mirror rebuild (SpotifyRepository.kt:840-857, 866-951, 955+).
- Only after that does it write the favourite, so the heart stays filled for the length of the rebuild.

Smaller inefficiency: UnifiedPlayerSheetV2's ~700-line body reads isFavorite (:209), so every heart tap recomposes the whole sheet body.

MINI PLAYER: no heart in either mode (MiniPlayerContentInternal, UnifiedPlayerSheetShared.kt:99; GlassMiniPlayerContent, :344; neither file mentions favourites).

LOCK SCREEN: already wired.
- MusicService builds a Like CommandButton, ICON_HEART_FILLED/UNFILLED, first in the media button preferences (MusicService.kt:2974-2984, 3024).
- It handles CUSTOM_COMMAND_LIKE optimistically (:768-778 → setCurrentSongFavoriteState :2768-2800).
- It re-syncs from Room when the app toggles (:993-1011; refreshMediaSessionUi debounced 250 ms, :295, :2626-2655).

(2) TRANSPORT:
- Material AnimatedPlaybackControls holds a skip squeeze for 600 ms versus releaseDelay (220 ms) for play/pause: AnimatedPlaybackControls.kt:100-109 (`NEXT, PREVIOUS -> 600L else -> releaseDelay`).
- The caller passes releaseDelay = 220L and a single motionScheme.fastSpatialSpec press spec for all three buttons (FullPlayerContent.kt:1315-1316, 1366-1384).
- The same 600 ms lastClicked also locks the play/pause icon after a skip: isPlayPauseLocked (:91-92, :126-133).
- Result: a skip stays morphed about 0.83 s against about 0.45 s for play/pause.
- ExternalPlayerOverlay.kt:322 uses the same composable.
- Glass mode is already uniform: GlassTransportRow (GlassPlayerControls.kt:55-100) uses three MediaOrbs with identical press motion (MediaOrb.kt:67-115, kitJelly with OrbPressScale, ControlKit.kt:233-267).

(3) TOP BAR:
- A Material3 TopAppBar inside Scaffold.topBar (FullPlayerContent.kt:754-997).
- title (:781-805): "Now Playing" (R.string.player_now_playing) plus Icons.Rounded.Cloud when contentUriString starts with "spotify:". It is hidden only while casting or connecting (:782-783).
- navigationIcon: 56 dp slot with the 42 dp collapse button; glass uses GlassPlayerCollapseButton (:806-834).
- Actions in Material (:850-993): the output pill (:856-966) and the 50×42 queue button (:968-992).
  - Label only for cast connecting or a remote route / Spotify Connect: chipRemoteActive / chipRouteName (:310-313, :856).
  - Bluetooth: icon only, and only by heuristic: BT enabled and any connected BT name (:857-858).
  - widthIn(min 50, max 190 with label, else 58) (:887-890); trailing corners morph 50↔6 dp (:864-875); remote dot (:953-960).
- Actions in glass: GlassPlayerTopActions (GlassPlayerControls.kt:207-265) has the same logic, GlassPlayerPill capped at widthIn(max = 190.dp) (:235).
- Wired/USB headphones are not detected at all.
- bluetoothName comes from ConnectivityStateHolder. It is "a connected BT audio device", not the routed output, and needs BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, which is requested only from the devices sheet (CastBottomSheet.kt:194). See ConnectivityStateHolder.kt:266-314.
alreadyOnAndroid:
- The favourite heart is already live in the full player (both modes), the lyrics More sheet and the song-info sheet. Nothing equivalent to the iOS @ObservationIgnored bug exists.
- The lock-screen / system media-controls Like is already wired, with an optimistic toggle and Room re-sync (MusicService.kt:768-778, 2768-2800, 2974-2984, 993-1011). The iOS 'wire the Like command' decision is already satisfied.
- The mini player has no heart in either mode.
- Glass-mode previous/next already press and settle exactly like play/pause (shared MediaOrb press, OrbPressScale).
- The output pill already:
  - morphs from a 50 dp icon-only split button to a full capsule with a name (Material);
  - shows the Cast route name and the Spotify Connect device name ("Playing on <device>"), with "Connecting…" plus a spinner while a cast connects and a remote dot;
  - hides "Now Playing" while casting.
- Icon-only pill width is already 50 dp, so there is no width change here (iOS goes 58 → 50).
- Localised generic output labels already exist (settings_devcaps_output_bluetooth/usb/wired/digital/other in strings_settings.xml:573-578, translated in 10 locales). A type → category mapping already exists (DeviceCapabilitiesViewModel.kt:545).
rootCause:
(1) No staleness root cause on Android: the heart is driven by a Room Flow → StateFlow → collectAsStateWithLifecycle → rememberUpdatedState provider read inside each toggle row (UnifiedPlayerSheetLayers.kt:221-227; FullPlayerContent.kt:2914; GlassPlayerControls.kt:118). The only user-visible delay is ordering. PlayerViewModel.toggleFavoriteSpecificSong (:2427-2436) runs the Explore clean-up (a full Spotify mirror rebuild, SpotifyRepository.kt:840-857) before writing the favourite. Unliking an Explore-only Spotify track therefore keeps the heart filled for the rebuild's duration. The Room round trip itself is a few frames.

(2) A ported constant: the 600 ms skip hold at AnimatedPlaybackControls.kt:103. The same lastClicked also drives the play/pause icon lock (:91-92). Shortening the hold alone would let the play/pause icon flash "Play" while a skipped-to stream buffers, so the two must be decoupled.

(3) A feature change. Structural constraints:
- TopAppBarMeasurePolicy (material3 1.5.0-alpha22, checked in bytecode) measures navigationIcon, then actionIcons with the bar's full constraints (copy minWidth=0), then title with what remains. A widened actions pill can therefore draw under the collapse button unless the actions reserve the leading area.
- The local output must come from the real media route: AudioManager.getAudioDevicesForAttributes, API 33+ (api-versions.xml:35027 since="33"; minSdk is 30). The "any connected BT device" heuristic is wrong when the user moves output to the speaker in the system Output Switcher, and it misses wired/USB.
- Compose Row with a weight(1f, fill=false) child wraps its content (RowColumnMeasurePolicy main-axis size = max(fixed + weighted, minWidth), checked in foundation-layout bytecode). The pill can use weight(1f, fill=false) to take the freed width and ellipsize.

recommendedPlan.change:
(1) Write the favourite first, then do the Explore clean-up. In toggleFavoriteSpecificSong (:2415-2438), after computing targetFavoriteState:
```kotlin
// The heart first: removeFromExploredCatalog rebuilds the whole Spotify mirror (seconds on a
// big library), and the heart only changes once Room has the new favourite.
setFavoriteStatusEverywhere(favoriteSongId, targetFavoriteState)
val spotifyId = song.spotifyId
if (!targetFavoriteState && spotifyId != null) {
    spotifyRepository.removeFromExploredCatalog(spotifyId)
}
```
This is safe: removeFromExploredCatalog / syncUnifiedLibrarySongsFromSpotify never touch the favorites table (SpotifyRepository.kt:840-951), and today both branches end with favourite = false anyway. Keep the existing explanatory comment (:2421-2426), reworded.

(3) Next to the connectivity delegates (:775-782), add one-line delegates; no new state in the VM:

val localAudioOutput: StateFlow<LocalAudioOutput> = connectivityStateHolder.localAudioOutput

(3) One source for both modes.

(a) Pure model and resolver (unit-tested):
```kotlin
internal enum class PlayerOutputKind { PHONE, BLUETOOTH, WIRED, USB, DIGITAL, OTHER, CAST, SPOTIFY_CONNECT }
@Immutable internal data class PlayerOutputUi(
    val kind: PlayerOutputKind, val name: String?, val isRemote: Boolean = false,
    val isConnecting: Boolean = false, val connectKind: SpotifyDeviceKind? = null)

internal fun resolvePlayerOutput(isCastConnecting: Boolean, isCastRemoteActive: Boolean, castRouteName: String?,
    connect: SpotifyConnectChip?, local: LocalAudioOutput): PlayerOutputUi = when {
    isCastConnecting -> PlayerOutputUi(CAST, null, isConnecting = true)
    connect != null -> PlayerOutputUi(SPOTIFY_CONNECT, connect.name, isRemote = !connect.connecting, isConnecting = connect.connecting, connectKind = connect.kind)
    isCastRemoteActive -> PlayerOutputUi(CAST, castRouteName?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }, isRemote = true)
    else -> when (local.category) { BuiltIn -> PlayerOutputUi(PHONE, null); Bluetooth -> PlayerOutputUi(BLUETOOTH, local.name); Usb -> PlayerOutputUi(USB, local.name); Wired -> PlayerOutputUi(WIRED, local.name); Cast -> PlayerOutputUi(DIGITAL, local.name); Other -> PlayerOutputUi(OTHER, local.name) }
}
```
This keeps today's precedence: Connect name before the cast route (FullPlayerContent.kt:312-313).

- PHONE → null (icon only, owner decision).
- isConnecting → stringResource(R.string.player_connecting) for cast; for Connect, the device name with a spinner.
- otherwise name ?: the generic label. Reuse the translated settings_devcaps_output_bluetooth/usb/wired/digital/other (strings_settings.xml:573-578) and R.string.player_cd_cast for an unnamed cast route.

- Layout:
```kotlin
Row(Modifier.padding(start = PlayerTopBarLeadingReserve, end = 14.dp),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
    if (glassMode) GlassPlayerOutputPill(output, label, onCastClick, Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false))
    else MaterialPlayerOutputPill(output, label, accent, onAccent, onCastClick, Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false))
    if (glassMode) GlassQueueOrb(onQueueClick) else MaterialQueueButton(accent, onAccent, onQueueClick) // moved from :968-992 / GlassPlayerControls.kt:253-263
}
/** TopAppBar measures actions at the bar's full width (before the title), so reserve its 4 dp inset + the 56 dp nav slot + a 12 dp gap or a long name draws under the collapse button. */
private val PlayerTopBarLeadingReserve = 72.dp
```
The Row wraps its content (weighted fill=false), and TopAppBar keeps it right-aligned. Max pill width ≈ bar − 146 dp (about 265 dp on a 412 dp Pixel 10 Pro).

risks: getAudioDevicesForAttributes exists only on API 33+ (api-versions.xml:35027; minSdk 30). Guard it with SDK_INT >= TIRAMISU and keep the getDevices priority fallback for 30-32. The fallback can be wrong when several sinks are connected; that is acceptable on old OS versions.

Moving output in the system Output Switcher (e.g. BT → phone speaker while BT stays connected) adds or removes no device, so AudioDeviceCallback doesn't fire. The plan adds an AudioPlaybackCallback and a refresh on expand. Whether onPlaybackConfigChanged fires on a pure route change must be checked on the Pixel 10 Pro (Android 16). If it doesn't, the pill corrects itself on the next expand or playback change.

Bluetooth names: AudioDeviceInfo.productName may come back blank or anonymised without BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, which the app requests only from the devices sheet (CastBottomSheet.kt:194). bluetoothName (the fallback) also needs it. Worst case the pill shows the generic 'Bluetooth audio'. Verify with the permission revoked.
The built-in speaker's productName is the phone model ('Pixel 10 Pro'). BuiltIn must always map to PHONE with no label, and any name equal to Build.MODEL is dropped.

TopAppBar internals: in material3 1.5.0-alpha22, actions are measured at the bar's full width before the title (checked in TopAppBarMeasurePolicy bytecode). Without the 72 dp leading reserve a long name draws under the collapse button. If material3 is bumped, re-check this or switch to the explicit-Row alternative.

Shortening only the weight hold would also shorten the play/pause icon lock (isPlayPauseLocked is derived from lastClicked, AnimatedPlaybackControls.kt:91-92). A streamed skip that resolves in more than about 0.27 s would then flash Play. The plan keeps a separate 600 ms icon lock; check by skipping between Spotify tracks.

The Explore-unlike reorder writes favourite = false before removing the track from the library. The final state is unchanged (the Spotify sync never touches the favorites table). For a second, the Liked list shows the track un-liked while it still exists in the library.
Very long Cast or Bluetooth names fill most of the bar and ellipsize 12 dp from the collapse button. Check at the narrowest supported width and with large font scale.

In glass mode, a resizing GlassPanel re-renders its lens each frame of the label's grow animation. This already happens today when casting starts; it is now more frequent (BT connect/disconnect), but only on output changes.

Shared files: PlayerViewModel (facade), ConnectivityStateHolder, SpotifyConnectStateHolder and UnifiedPlayerSheetV2/Layers. Keep these as small separate commits with reasons. The lyrics item edits LyricsMoreBottomSheet and the glass-expansion item must not touch the player top bar. This plan leaves LyricsMoreBottomSheet alone.

Pre-existing, out of scope (note in the handoff): MusicService's lock-screen Like keys by mediaId (MusicService.kt:2772-2794), while the app resolves external ids (PlayerViewModel.kt:2440-2472). For non-numeric external ids the lock-screen heart flips in memory, but MusicRepositoryImpl.setFavoriteStatus returns early (:815). Songs whose favourite id can't be resolved never show a heart change.
Nobody has run this on device. Per AGENTS.md, ask before installing on or driving the owner's phone.
tests: ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "com.theveloper.pixelplay.presentation.viewmodel.PlayerViewModelTest" (new order test plus the existing favourite tests at :476-529)
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest (full suite) and ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug; also :baselineprofile compiles if the pattern is edited

Device, after asking the owner (Pixel 10 Pro, Android 16), heart: tap it in Material and glass full player, the lyrics More sheet and song info. Use a local song and a Spotify song, plus unliking an Explore-only Spotify track. The heart should flip within a frame or two without touching shuffle or repeat.
Device, lock-screen / QS media controls: Like toggles and the in-app heart follows; toggling in the app updates the lock-screen heart within about 250 ms.

Device, transport: previous/next squeeze and settle in the same ~0.45 s as play/pause (Material). Skipping between streamed Spotify tracks must not flash the Play icon. Glass orbs are unchanged. Check the External player overlay too.
Device, the queue button and devices sheet still open from the top bar in both modes, and the baseline-profile benchmark still finds 'Collapse player'.
ownerDecisions: Spotify Connect pill icon: the device-type icon (speaker / TV / car, via spotifyDeviceIcon; recommended, matches iOS's device symbol) or today's cast icon?
Generic label when the system gives no device name: reuse the existing translated 'Bluetooth audio' / 'USB audio' / 'Wired audio' / 'Digital output' / 'Other output' (recommended), or show icon only?

Only if the on-device check shows a visible delay on the heart (not expected): add an optimistic favourite overlay (a pending-favourites map in the repository flow)? Recommended: no; the Explore-unlike reorder covers the only real lag.
